text:
jana: Noticed a surge in SCIM deprovision events after today's RBAC cleanup and a KMS alias rotate. Logs show decrypt header mismatches and missing audit rows. Anyone oncall?

kartik: I'm on. Sample log: 
```
2026-05-02T11:02:13Z provisioner ERROR tenant=stellardev scim=deprov kms_err=EnvelopeHeaderMismatch expected_kid=arn:aws:kms:...:key/A got=arn:aws:kms:...:key/B
2026-05-02T11:02:13Z audit WARN tenant=stellardev missing_row action=deprovision actor=svc:scim-provisioner
```

ryan: EnvelopeHeaderMismatch = cached envelope encrypted to old key. Did we swap alias before rewrapping?

miriam: We rotated the org alias at 10:55 UTC (per change-log) and RBAC prune landed at 11:00. Rewrap job was scheduled but failed with lambda timeout.

jana: That explains the two symptoms: decrypt fails -> fallback errors; RBAC prune changed attribute mapping (email->persistent) so some NameID lookups returned nil and triggered deprovs.

ops-bot: ALERT scim-deprov-surge severity=high tenants_impacted=7 events=312 incident=INC-2026-211 created_by=ops-bot

kartik: Immediate steps: 1) flip SCIM to "deferred" mode (ack+queue); 2) pause RBAC prune rollouts; 3) snapshot envelopes, then rewrap using old_kid->new_kid process.

miriam: I'll open an incident ticket and loop in Compliance for audit backfill sign-off. We cannot fabricate timestamps; backfilled audit rows must be marked.

ryan: Repro steps locally: pull envelope from redis, run aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://env.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/A -> success; run with key/B -> EnvelopeHeaderMismatch.

kartik: Rewrap plan: lambda rewraper (idempotent), detect envelope version v1/v2, decrypt with provided old_kid(s), re-encrypt to current alias, write manifest s3://sec/envelopes/incident-1977001111/manifest.csv. Throttle concurrency to 8.

jana: Also add a transient NameID shim in IdP to accept legacy email format for 48h. That reduces false deprovs while we rewrap.

miriam: Compliance note: observed ~14 missing authn/audit events across tenants during the change window. We'll collect raw queue and attach to backfill justification.

ops-bot: NOTE incident INC-2026-211 state=investigating owners=[kartik,ryan,miriam] sla=72h

kartik: Running a small rewrap batch now (sample 100). Posting progress.

ryan: I'll own audit backfill once we get legal signoff. Plan: replay raw queue, reconcile against final provisioner state, insert audit rows with field backfill_reason="kms_alias_rotate_no_rewrap".

jana: Flipped IdP shim; monitoring shows provisioner deprov errors drop ~90% for shimmed tenants.

kartik: Rewrap progress: 
```
2026-05-02T12:18:09Z rewrap INFO tenant=stellardev rewrapped=100/1200 old_kid=key/A new_kid=key/B
```

miriam: Good. After full rewrap: run end-to-end test (decrypt sample envelopes, perform SCIM reconcile, verify audit insertion). Then remove IdP shim and resume RBAC prune.

ops-bot: UPDATE incident INC-2026-211 owners=[kartik,ryan,miriam] state=mitigating updates=4

jana: Postmortem items: enforce pre-rotation checklist (snapshot+test+maintenance-mode), harden rewrap lambda (longer timeout, idempotency), and gate RBAC changes when key or IdP rotations are in-flight.

kartik: Agreed. I'll add detection to alert if EnvelopeHeaderMismatch spikes after a rotation and auto-safelist tenants for deferred mode.

miriam: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread for incident comms. I'll draft customer-facing blurb once we have backfill ETA.
